question: Which universal part of the local-neighbor direction is most impactful: coherence length, distance falloff, or baryonic source weighting?
coordinate_rule: Vary one coordinate at a time around the parent; duplicate parent values are evaluated once.
field_law: v_i=sum_{j!=i} w_j^(p_w) (x_j-x_i)/(distance_ij^2+s^2)^((p_d+1)/2), followed by unit normalization

evaluation.source_positions: profiled on training images separately for each formula
evaluation.primary_scope: equal-system held-out Jacobian-linearized RMS over the four systems other than MACS1931

claim_limits: This is a spent-data fixed-geometry local-response sensitivity analysis, not an exact root test.
The member catalog omits accepted registered gas and diffuse ICL.
Parameter optima may absorb catalog selection and projected-geometry artifacts.
Galaxy, radial-CLASH, and Solar values are unchanged by construction.
A candidate must pass a separately frozen exact-refit and global-root test before any stronger interpretation.
